           SCOTT EQUITY EXCHANGE CO.
           2026 WHEAT DELAYED PRICE

             Effective July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027
Scott:
Wheat – Delayed Price (DP) Rates
Drop Charge: None
Rate: $0.08 per bushel per month
(Pro-rated daily at $0.00267 per bushel per day)
Effective Period: From date of delivery through June 30, 2027

Van Wert:
Wheat – Delayed Price (DP) Rates
Drop Charge: None
Rate: $0.08 per bushel per month
(Pro-rated daily at $0.00267 per bushel per day)
Effective Period: From date of delivery through June 30, 2027

Early Sale Exemption:
Wheat sold within 10 calendar days of delivery will have all Delayed Price
charges waived.

🔔 Important Reminders

On June 30, any wheat remaining in Delayed Price will be subject to
Upcoming Year New Rate Schedule.

All accrued DP charges will be billed to the patron's account on June 30
yearly.

If you are utilizing Delayed Price and do not have a current agreement on
file, please request and return a completed agreement within 10 days of
delivery.

Note: Rates and policies are subject to change without notice due to market
conditions.
